RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel alone does not prove discrimination; it frequently reflects demographic imbalances in senior clinical leadership. However, homogeneous panels carry a recognized risk of affinity bias, especially when weighing subjective factors like "broad leadership experience" against your doctorate and eight years of section management.

Do not raise the panel's gender composition in isolation yet. First, follow up on your request for written feedback. When you receive it, assess whether objective scoring criteria were applied consistently and whether the organization violated its own panel-diversity policies. If the explanation relies on vague, subjective justifications despite your credentials, consult an employment lawyer or union representative before raising the issue formally.
